Star Trek: Strange New Worlds | A Dragon Attacks the Enterprise (S4, E9) | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
Taking the form of a fearsome dragon, Queen Neve (Celia R. Gooding) attacks the Enterprise, jeopardizing Sir Roth (Anson Mount) and Pollux’s (Ethan Peck) charade as Captain Pike and Mr. Spock. Meanwhile on the planet below, La’An (Christina Chong) duels her fantasy dopplegänger, Princess Thalia. Season 4, Episode 9: Once La’An a Time
